fonts.display: 'Apk Galeria', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Apkpraktikal', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Carbon Ink
palette.role: Primary text, hero CTA button fill, logo mark — the dominant non-white color carrying 1000+ borders and all body copy

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Secondary surface fill, dark card backgrounds, button borders — one step lighter than Carbon for layered elements

palette.name: Iron
palette.role: Body text, input borders, button borders, card borders — the working neutral for readable secondary copy

palette.name: Steel
palette.role: Muted headings, subhead text, supporting borders

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Subtle heading text, dividers, light borders

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Image borders, icon borders, tertiary text

palette.name: Silver
palette.role: Link borders, decorative dividers, lightest structural lines

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Soft surface fills, secondary button backgrounds, subtle wash backgrounds

palette.name: Canvas White
palette.role: Page background, card surface, button text on dark fills

palette.name: Ice Blue
palette.role: Feature card surfaces, soft highlight panels — the only tinted neutral, used to frame product previews and walkthrough banners

palette.name: Cobalt Spark
palette.role: Wayfinding dots beside section eyebrows, icon accents, link color — the navigation accent, never used as a fill

palette.name: Lime Glow
palette.role: Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.
